metadata.name: Ravager Class Tree
metadata.description: Single continuous web. The Path of Ruin runs up the centre and is what fills Fervour from enemies in reach. Unbreaking lower-left, Sundering upper-left, Scorched Earth upper-right, Relentless lower-right. Keystones sit at the far end of each limb and need full investment in their parent. The four onslaught capstones are the 25/50/100/200 point tiers and stand apart from the web.

data.name: Fervour
data.description: Enemies in reach generate Fervour: 1 for each enemy your attacks hit, and 1 per second for every enemy within 4 metres of you. While you have this, Fervour decays at 5 per second after 3 seconds with no enemy within 4 metres, so losing contact is what empties it rather than a timer.

options.name: Wade In
options.description: Each enemy within 4 metres of you grants 3% increased Armor and 3% increased Attack Damage.

options.name: Firewalker

options.name: Headlong

data.name: The Second Onslaught

options.name: Bank the Heat

options.name: Long Hold

options.name: Shoulder Through

data.name: The Final Onslaught
data.description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: Firestorm Made Flesh
options.description: Killing a burning enemy spreads its burn to everything within 4 metres, and each burning enemy within 8 metres grants you 3% more damage.

options.name: The Whole Field

options.name: Nothing Stops It
options.description: You cannot be brought below 1 health by a single hit. When a hit would have done so you take no damage for 2 seconds, no more than once every 20 seconds.
